name: Halloween Otome
source:
"You want a… demonstration of what my party will be like? Very well. I grant you one.

You are cordially invited to the Annual Valdemar Halloween Extravaganza. Two weeks of luxury await you. Let’s see if you can keep up the masquerade…"

Halloween Otome is an otome visual novel in which the protagonist, Emma Cee (name changeable) wins an invite to a most exclusive and sought out Halloween getaway. What she doesn't realise is that it's far from relaxing. The Halloween getaway turns out to be a annual game hosted for the rich and famous and every contestant is thrown into miscellaneous groups, challenged over the course of 2 weeks.

[From [url=https://synokoria.itch.io/halloween-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你想要……展示一下我的派对会是什么样子？很好。我同意你。

诚挚邀请你参加一年一度的瓦尔德马万圣节盛会。两周的奢华等待着你。让我们看看你能否继续这场假面舞会……”

《万圣节乙女》是一部乙女视觉小说，主角艾玛·西（Emma Cee，名字可更改）赢得了最独特、最受追捧的万圣节度假的邀请。她没有意识到这远非放松。万圣节度假原来是一项为富人和名人举办的年度游戏，每位参赛者都被分成不同的组，在两周的时间内接受挑战。

[来自[url=https://synokoria.itch.io/halloween-otome]痒痒io[/url]]
